item: Original external lineage for unchanged Fiji_v2.5 parameters
why_absent: The runtime case retained parameter JSONs but not a complete six-ledger source package for the inherited CLEWs Global values.
upgrade_source: Recover the exact CLEWs Global country-build release, raw input tables and transformation scripts; replace SRC_FIJI_V25_CASE mappings parameter by parameter.
notes: All inherited values are still traceable to the immediate v2.5 source case.

why_absent: Omitted at the user's direction; public URLs and exact locators are the operative traceability mechanism for this migration.
upgrade_source: Retain immutable evidence files and calculate verified SHA-256 values if an integrity freeze is later required.
notes: All SOURCES.sha256 cells are intentionally blank.

item: Legacy local evidence extracts referenced by phase ledgers
why_absent: The phase JSONs name evidence files that are not present in the current repository working tree.
upgrade_source: Re-export the cited UNSD/EFL/FAOSTAT extracts from their public products and retain them under the canonical evidence directory.
notes: Provider URLs, query codes and values were migrated so the extracts can be reconstructed.

item: Measured Fiji thermal plant heat rates and fuel split
why_absent: EFL reports combined IDO/HFO consumption; the model uses an aggregate fleet coefficient and NCV midpoint.
upgrade_source: Plant-level fuel-consumption and net-generation records split by fuel.
notes: Disclosed in Phase 1F.

why_absent: No defensible Fiji crop-specific forecast was retained.
upgrade_source: Ministry crop outlook or climate-adjusted agronomic yield pathways.
notes: 2022 multipliers are held constant.

item: Spatial crop allocation and irrigation intensity
why_absent: Phase 1G calibrated national crop groups but not observed allocation across land classes or water-management intensity.
upgrade_source: Geocoded Fiji Agriculture Census parcels, irrigated-area maps and crop water requirements.
notes: Cropland and equipped-irrigation are continuing ceilings, not forced shares.

why_absent: Fiji v2.6 closes inherited Fiji v2.5 water coefficients exactly but does not claim a new observed hydrological calibration.
upgrade_source: National water balance, AQUASTAT, calibrated runoff/recharge/ET estimates and withdrawal/consumption data.
notes: ENV_WATER is an exact model account, not an observed water balance.

why_absent: The model contains no land-conversion technologies or sourced transition pathways.
upgrade_source: Annual national land-cover change series and policy-constrained land-transition technologies.
notes: Fixed natural/built/water/bare stocks are initial stocks carried through the horizon.

item: Observed service demands and device/fleet efficiencies
why_absent: Phase 1J derives exploratory services from public carrier totals and transparent engineering assumptions.
upgrade_source: Household survey, vehicle-km/passenger-km, aviation/navigation activity and technology-stock/efficiency data.
notes: Not fit for official demand forecasts.

item: Observed future fuel prices and adoption pathways
why_absent: Future prices and adoption caps are scenario assumptions, not observations.
upgrade_source: Government-approved energy-price scenarios and technology roadmaps with costs and stock turnover.
notes: Central/low/high values are explicit in ASSUMPTIONS.csv.

item: 2024 UNSD estimated observations as fixed history
why_absent: OBS_STATUS=E values were retained as evidence but deliberately not promoted as observed fixed history.
upgrade_source: Final UNSD release or Fiji national energy balance for 2024.
notes: History ends in 2023.

why_absent: The case is solved and source-indexed but retains significant inherited/proxy parameters and fixed-history constructs.
upgrade_source: Complete calibration assessment, uncertainty analysis and independent national review.
notes: Use is limited to exploratory national scenarios.

why_absent: The implemented SSP2-4.5 pathway is a smooth national annual multiplier derived from 20-year climatologies; it does not represent year-to-year variability, drought sequences, cyclones or spatial gradients.
upgrade_source: Bias-corrected Fiji gridded daily/monthly CMIP6 ensemble with a documented downscaling and weather-sequence method.
notes: Do not interpret the interpolated annual values as forecasts of individual years.

why_absent: Evapotranspiration, recharge and runoff are scaled proportionally with precipitation to preserve the inherited partition; no Fiji-specific nonlinear hydrology model was calibrated.
upgrade_source: Calibrated Fiji basin water balances and climate-sensitive ET/recharge/runoff response functions.
notes: ENV_WATER remains an exact account of the implemented coefficients rather than a hydrological forecast.

why_absent: CCKP p10 and p90 anomaly values are preserved in the source JSON but only the ensemble median is implemented in SC_0.
upgrade_source: Create separately named low/central/high precipitation scenarios using the retained p10/median/p90 values and validate each solve.
notes: The central result should not be treated as the full uncertainty range.

item: Fisheries vessel fuel and facility energy survey
why_absent: FAO engineering intensities and an analytical aquaculture electricity intensity substitute for a Fiji bottom-up fuel and electricity inventory.
upgrade_source: Obtain Fiji fleet logs by segment and metered hatchery farm ice cold-store and processing energy data.
notes: Capture, aquaculture and post-harvest service levels carry material uncertainty.

item: Fisheries asset stock and investment costs
why_absent: Residual stock ages, technology capital costs and fixed O&M are transparent engineering assumptions rather than a Fiji asset census and market survey.
upgrade_source: Inventory vessel engines aquaculture equipment ice plants cold stores processors and solar freezers with commissioning years and delivered costs.
notes: Investment results are suitable for screening rather than procurement.

why_absent: An aggregate observed-boundary ceiling is encoded, but it is not stock-assessment-based and no effort cap, fleet-entry rule or spatial fisheries constraint is represented.
upgrade_source: Use current WCPFC and Fiji stock assessments plus licensed fleet and management-plan limits.
notes: The aggregate ceiling is a screening proxy rather than a biological production forecast.

why_absent: Feed production, feed conversion ratios, species-specific survival and material balances are outside the implemented service boundary.
upgrade_source: Collect Fiji species-level feed use FCR mortality stocking and harvest records.
notes: Aquaculture is represented as a useful-energy service only.

why_absent: The aggregate programme ceiling restricts expansion, but site land occupation, freshwater use, effluent and nutrient loading are not explicit.
upgrade_source: Obtain facility-level pond or cage area water abstraction discharge nutrient and treatment data.
notes: Do not use the case for aquaculture water-quality permitting.

why_absent: Fish by-products, organic wastewater load, refrigerant inventories and fugitive emissions are absent.
upgrade_source: Audit Fiji processing yields by-products COD/BOD treatment systems refrigerants and leakage.
notes: Only process water and energy-related emissions are represented.

why_absent: Post-harvest demand is based on a declared share of offshore longline catch; coastal commercial and subsistence preservation are not quantified.
upgrade_source: Survey landing-site ice drying smoking storage spoilage and household processing by fishery.
notes: Current boundary is conservative and explicitly incomplete.

item: Resident food availability versus nutritional requirement
why_absent: FAOSTAT food availability is used to anchor resident demand; it is not a dietary adequacy recommendation and the model has no nutrition module.
upgrade_source: Develop Fiji dietary requirement scenarios using Ministry of Health nutrition guidance, household consumption surveys, edible fractions and loss/waste evidence.
notes: Applies to both crop and fish final demand.

item: Population-only future food and trade trajectories
why_absent: Per-capita resident food, import floors and export commitments are held constant; income, prices, preferences, substitution and foreign-market growth are outside the model.
upgrade_source: Add explicit user-selected diet and trade scenarios or link a demand/trade model with documented elasticities.
notes: The implemented case is intentionally not a behavioral trade model.

why_absent: The selected 2025 crop flows use UN Comtrade physical export weights; detailed domestic/re-export physical separation is not published for every selected code.
upgrade_source: Obtain Fiji Customs transaction-level domestic export and re-export net weights by HS code.
notes: Fiji's annual release distinguishes values but not all required physical quantities.

why_absent: Coconut products are mapped one-for-one and a negligible husked-rice flow uses a screening coefficient; product-specific processing yields are incomplete.
upgrade_source: Compile Fiji mill and processor mass balances for coconut, rice and other processed crop products.
notes: Rice milled and raw sugar conversions have Fiji SUA support; other conversions are disclosed approximations.

item: Fisheries retained-import timing and missing weights
why_absent: Same-year re-exports may originate from earlier inventories and HS160431 reports value but no net weight.
upgrade_source: Obtain Fiji Customs consignment-level origin, regime, inventory timing and physical net weights.
notes: Current proxy floors negative code-level import-minus-re-export values at zero.

item: Aggregate fish market-weight and processing yield
why_absent: Species, preservation state, edible fraction, processing loss and by-product conversion are not represented in FSHRAW/FSHFOOD.
upgrade_source: Build species/product-specific Fiji landings, processing yields, edible fractions and loss/waste accounts.
notes: Current raw-to-food ratio is one-to-one.

why_absent: Aggregate source-traceable annual ceilings now differentiate the two supply routes and prevent unlimited least-cost substitution, but resource-specific and biological limits remain aggregated.
upgrade_source: Calibrate species-level aquaculture feed/FCR/site constraints and stock-assessment-linked capture limits plus comparable full costs.
notes: The current mix is fit for national screening only and is not a species-level forecast.
